name: a-configured-citation-cannot-be-declined-by-a-request
description: SPEC.md 4.2 (v1.18): citation obeys the precedence every request field obeys - what the deployment configured wins, then the request, then off. A deployment that must cite, such as one giving regulated answers, configured it with its own prefix; a caller asking for no citation still receives the cited answer.
